title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: 1st Set: Beyer M160 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> SHN2nd Set: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with a smoking Space → Aiko jam and killer China Cat > I Know You Rider transition.
ai_review.review: The SBD of this September‑14‑1982 concert is generally clear, with only occasional hiss or mic crackle.  The performance is a fan favorite – the first set is solid and the second set erupts into an unforgettable Space‑Aiko jam, a tight China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue, and standout moments like “He’s Gone” and “High Time.”

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ≈ 4.1 across 24 reviews, with the vast majority praising both music and tape; recording is solid soundboard with minor quirks, so a strong positive score is warranted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp SBD capture; occasional mic hiss (“bacon frying”) and mix quirks (Phil’s bass sometimes recessed) but overall clean and listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set followed by an expansive, jam‑heavy second set; transitions flow smoothly and the set builds to a high‑energy climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sweet tone on “High Time” and overall hot guitar work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted smoking his stage monitor after Rider; bass audible and strong in mix on this SBD, with a few reviewers mentioning typical 1982 SBD bass quirks.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for tight interplay with Jerry during the Space‑Aiko jam and overall solid rhythm work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard playing shines especially during China Cat Sunflower and its transition; keyboards praised as “tight, highly sensitive.”
